assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE regular 3-by-3 crop atlas of eight entirely new waist-up characters and one setting tile for a first-grade lesson. Flat warm cream backgrounds, exactly equal square cells, thin straight gutters at thirds. Original matte gouache cut-paper with fine paper grain, warm cream, pine, apricot and persimmon. No text, numbers, blank signs, speech balloons, watermarks or textbook characters. Simple well-separated silhouettes readable at 60 pixels, both shoulders and hair in frame. Each tile isolated. Row 1 left: child presenter, a 7-year-old girl with a yellow hair clip, chestnut braid and dusty mint pullover, smiling and holding a plain dark handheld microphone. Row 1 middle: her mother, a brown-skinned adult woman with short tight black curls, warm yellow striped blouse, recognizable and smiling. Row 1 right: her father, a brown-skinned adult man with short wavy hair, neat small beard, and muted turquoise sweater. Row 2 left: her grandmother, an older brown-skinned woman with gray braids and a clearly persimmon-red scarf. Row 2 middle: her grandfather, an older brown-skinned man with silver gray hair and a pale blue cardigan, no cap. Row 2 right: her new child friend, a dark-skinned 7-year-old boy with white cap and orange overalls, an open palm waving, full hand in the cell. Row 3 left: a second child presenter, a 7-year-old boy with dark brown curly hair, red sweater and small cream collar, holding a plain dark handheld microphone. Row 3 middle: that boy's father, light-brown-skinned adult with purple gingham overshirt, green brimmed cap and no beard. Row 3 right: an empty community shadow-puppet exhibit welcome setting, an arched doorway, two plain round paper lanterns and a wide clean floor area, no people or writing.
